_about: Real cities for the long hauls. Miles are road miles from the home garage in Columbia; 'via' names the road the truck takes out of town; 'region' picks the scenery on the highway leg.

home.name: Columbia
home.tagline: The capital, the river, and a garage with a roll-up door.

cities.name: Lexington
cities.tagline: Lake Murray weekends and a main street that still closes for parades.

cities.name: Camden
cities.tagline: Horse country. The Cup, the pines, the porches.

cities.name: Newberry
cities.tagline: An opera house on a town square.

cities.name: Orangeburg
cities.tagline: Rose gardens and the Edisto.

cities.name: Sumter
cities.tagline: Swan Lake and the iris gardens.

cities.name: Aiken
cities.tagline: Wide avenues laid out for carriages.

cities.name: Rock Hill
cities.tagline: Old mills turned into lofts.

cities.name: Greenwood
cities.tagline: A main street wide enough for a railroad.

cities.name: Florence
cities.tagline: Where the interstates cross the Pee Dee.

cities.name: Spartanburg
cities.tagline: Peach stands on every road in.

cities.name: Summerville
cities.tagline: Flowertown. Azaleas, and the sweet tea was invented here, they say.

cities.name: Greenville
cities.tagline: A waterfall in the middle of downtown.

cities.name: Charleston
cities.tagline: Rainbow Row, the harbour, church bells over the market.

cities.name: Anderson
cities.tagline: Lake Hartwell and the Electric City.

cities.name: Georgetown
cities.tagline: Rice fields gone back to marsh, a harbourwalk.

cities.name: Beaufort
cities.tagline: Live oaks over the water, porches on every house.

cities.name: Clemson
cities.tagline: Orange everywhere. The lake on the other days.

cities.name: Conway
cities.tagline: A riverwalk on the Waccamaw.

cities.name: Myrtle Beach
cities.tagline: Sixty miles of beach and a Ferris wheel.

cities.name: Hilton Head Island
cities.tagline: Bike paths under the pines, the lighthouse at Harbour Town.

cities.name: Augusta
cities.tagline: Across the Savannah River. Azaleas in April.

cities.name: Charlotte
cities.tagline: The skyline you can see from the state line.

cities.name: Savannah
cities.tagline: Squares under Spanish moss.

cities.name: Asheville
cities.tagline: Up into the mountains. The air changes at the line.

cities.name: Wilmington
cities.tagline: A riverfront and the ocean twenty minutes on.

cities.name: Atlanta
cities.tagline: The big one. Six lanes each way and a client who tips.

cities.name: Raleigh
cities.tagline: Oaks and universities.

cities.name: Knoxville
cities.tagline: Over the Smokies and down the other side.

cities.name: Jacksonville
cities.tagline: Palms at the welcome centre, the St. Johns bridges.

cities.name: Nashville
cities.tagline: Two days if the radio holds out. The longest haul there is.
